testimonials.title: What Our Users Say
testimonials.subtitle: Discover how Reham Diva has transformed the lives of women around the world.

items.name: Nesreen Tafesh
items.text: One of the most important consciousness teachers in the Arab world with a blend of intelligence and kindness and a comfortable, heart-warming style. She presents her materials in a smooth, understandable way for different levels of consciousness. I expect her to continue with strong impact, which will enable beautiful spiritual consciousness shifts for many in our Arab world, especially women.

items.name: Dr. Fawz Al-Drai
items.role: Specialist in Psychological, Spiritual and Sexual Culture
items.text: There are those who start their work and there are those who start their work - Reham Al-Rashidi has started. Great... authentic... majestic and at all levels: idea and thought, plan and implementation... stability and change. Without a doubt, she is a distinguished addition in the world of self-development, and perhaps the strongest thing about her is that her self was the first project, so the performance was sincere and successful. I feel that her creativity box is in the peak of legitimate pride and it tells us (there is still much more). We are proud of her and reassured that the space of truth in the world of human spiritual development is in good hands.

items.name: Kinda Alloush
items.text: Her presence and appearance caught my attention before I knew her specialty... and when she spoke, I recognized a strong, confident personality capable of convincing everyone of her ideas with calm and gentleness. For a woman to defend women and their existence in society through the weapon of femininity without asking her to change her skin or imitate men, and to confirm through her proposals and ideas the enhancement of women's self-confidence and charging their inner strength without this affecting the essence of their difference, which is softness, tenderness, and femininity in all its manifestations. This is what Reham insisted on and what she was able to achieve through her great influence on a wide segment of women in Kuwait and the Arab world...

items.name: Samir Al-Qaisi
items.role: Journalist, News Anchor and Program Host, Humanitarian Activist
items.text: I follow Reham Al-Rashidi with enthusiasm to launch into my world, enjoying my complete femininity... I soar... I flourish... and I enjoy...

items.name: Dr. Mustafa Abu Saad
items.role: Psychological and Educational Consultant, Family and Educational Guidance Trainer, Author of Educational Books
items.text: Reham Al-Rashidi has unlimited ambition and unstoppable creativity. My daughter Reham is distinguished by her scientific ambition and her awareness towards specializing in a neglected and new field that deeply penetrates the world of women in order to restore balance to herself, elevate her femininity, and make her happy. May God guide her, and my advice is that she continues as I have known her while maintaining our Islamic identity and reference that contains tranquility, balance, and happiness in both worlds.

items.question: How many programs are included in the Reham Diva curriculum?
items.answer: The Reham Diva curriculum includes 6 comprehensive programs in feminine awareness and self-love, with over 40 hours of training and more than 250 lessons

items.question: What is the duration of membership in the Reham Diva curriculum?
items.answer: You get a golden membership in the Reham Diva curriculum that lasts for 3 full years through the website

items.question: How can I stay updated on all Reham Diva curriculum activities?
items.answer: You can find out about upcoming curriculum activities by accessing the calendar in the main menu of the website, and the upcoming activity will also appear on the homepage once you log in to the website. You can add activities to your mobile phone calendar to get reminders

items.question: What are the details of my membership in the Reham Diva club?
items.answer: The Reham Diva club allows you to ask questions directly to Reham and listen to participants' experiences, which energizes you and motivates you to continue your personal journey in a positive and enlightened community. Your annual membership in the Reham Diva club allows you to attend 6 live meetings with Reham during the first year of the curriculum. You can attend in person in Kuwait or follow the live broadcast from your country and get recordings of all meetings to watch at your convenience

items.question: When are the Reham Diva club meeting schedules?
items.answer: You will receive an email from us to notify you of the Reham Diva club meeting times, in addition to the activity appearing in your calendar within the website. We suggest adding the dates to your personal mobile phone calendar for easy reminder of appointments

items.question: Where can I get the training workbook?
items.answer: You can find the training workbook in the first lesson of each new chapter, and for additional materials, you can find the training workbook on the additional material page

items.question: How can I contact the Reham House team?
items.answer: You can send an email to hello@reham.com or contact via WhatsApp +96550406406. We are always at your service

items.question: Why do training materials appear gradually in the curriculum?
items.answer: The gradual appearance of materials makes it easier for you to complete the journey without feeling overwhelmed by the amount of available content. The order of material appearance is carefully planned by Ms. Reham. We want to reassure you that you won't log into the website and find a small amount of content, as we continuously open materials - you will always find plenty of content that you can enjoy watching and benefiting from. However, this will be done gradually according to the teachings of the feminine curriculum

items.question: What are the terms and conditions for refunds?
items.answer: We are happy to help you with refunds if the program doesn't meet your expectations, provided that the refund request is made during the golden guarantee period, which is within thirty days from the date of purchasing the program by contacting the Reham House team via email at Hello@reham.com

items.question: How can I keep the materials for life?
items.answer: You can keep the materials for life through the download feature that appears to you after one month from the subscription date in the curriculum

items.question: What distinguishes Reham Diva platform courses from Reham Al-Rashidi's free content on YouTube?
items.answer: The Reham platform gives you full access to all femininity and self-love programs and courses offered by Ms. Reham Al-Rashidi. They differ from YouTube in that YouTube offers general awareness programs for those who want to learn from a distance, while the Reham Diva platform is a set of programs with a practical and training methodology for those who want to create real and deep change in their lives.

items.question: What distinguishes Reham Al-Rashidi's courses from other femininity courses?
items.answer: Ms. Reham Al-Rashidi is considered the first femininity coach in the Arab world, and has received recognition from the Kuwait Ministry of State for Youth Affairs that the Reham Diva curriculum is one of the top 10 youth educational projects in Kuwait. When you subscribe to Reham Diva courses you get original, exclusive materials by Ms. Reham Al-Rashidi, with Reham House retaining intellectual property rights for the courses and programs. These courses have been tried for more than 10 years with real success stories from subscribers.

items.question: I feel I have lost my femininity. Will these programs help me regain it?
items.answer:
Yes, absolutely. Ms. Reham's courses help you reconnect with your femininity whether you are
• single or married
• a mother
• a businesswoman or leader
• focused on the home
• employed or a student

items.question: Do I need any prior background to start these courses?
items.answer: You do not need any prior background. All you need is a genuine desire and passion for knowledge and change. The training programs are very deep but simple in Reham Al-Rashidi's style (the easy-yet-profound).

items.question: From what age can women or girls benefit from Reham Diva programs?
items.answer: From age 16 to 60. All that is required is your passion and desire to learn and change.

items.question: Who is Reham Al-Rashidi and what are her qualifications?
items.answer:
Ms. Reham Al-Rashidi is the first femininity coach in the Arab world
Over 10 years of experience in courses
Over 15,000 beneficiaries of paid programs and over 360,000 beneficiaries of free programs; over 1 million followers on social media
Mechanical Engineering graduate from Kuwait University
Certified coach from the World Council for Training, Teaching and Coaching
Certified coach from the International Academy for Training and Consulting
Certified coach from Franchaiz Al-Rashed in Personal Life Planning
Certified coach in marital relationships
Certified coach in childhood education

items.question: Is the content updated regularly?
items.answer: Yes. When you subscribe to the platform, you gain access to all existing programs as well as any new and additional training materials. If a live session with Ms. Reham is held, you can attend and ask your questions about the programs via live broadcast from your country, and you will also receive full recordings of the sessions.

items.question: Can I access the courses from my mobile phone?
items.answer: Yes, and through smart devices such as laptop and iPad.

items.question: Are the lessons live or pre-recorded?
items.answer: All programs are recorded. You can follow them at your convenience from your country. When there is any live broadcast in Reham Diva club, the session video is uploaded within a few days so you can watch the recordings.

items.question: Can I download lessons to watch offline?
items.answer: Download is not available, but you can access all materials when you subscribe via the website www.RehamDiva.com

items.question: How long does the content remain available to me after purchase?
items.answer: All platform materials are available to you according to your subscription type, whether monthly or annual.

items.question: What is the difference between buying a single course and an annual subscription?
items.answer: No need to hesitate. When you subscribe to the Reham Diva platform you get all programs and courses displayed on the website.

items.question: Is there a money-back guarantee?
items.answer: Yes, and it is your right. For monthly subscription you have 14 days from the subscription date to request a refund. For annual subscription you have 30 days from the subscription date to request a refund. The guarantee is 100% of the amount with no fees deducted. We trust our content and want you to feel confident in your decision.

items.question: Does my subscription renew automatically? How can I cancel it?
items.answer: Yes. Like all platforms and apps with monthly subscriptions, the subscription renews periodically whether monthly or annually. Cancellation is easy through your account page after subscribing.

items.question: Do you offer certified completion certificates?
items.answer: We do not offer certified completion certificates, as the aim is educational for personal change.

items.question: How can I become a certified femininity coach?
items.answer: Ms. Reham and the Reham House team are looking into offering certified femininity coaching certificates according to the Reham Diva curriculum, and an announcement will be made in due time. Until then you can prepare by reviewing and applying the training materials and choosing your preferred topic for future certification, noting that this will require you to obtain a certified coach certificate from bodies that offer training certification.

items.question: Can I republish the training materials and programs on my accounts or offer them as training programs?
items.answer: All programs on the Reham Diva platform are protected by intellectual property rights owned by Reham Al-Rashidi and Reham House. They are for personal use only and may not be published for any commercial purpose. Legal action will be taken if this is violated. Republishing content in your own style with proper attribution is allowed and appreciated.

items.question: Will I be able to communicate with the coach directly?
items.answer: Yes. You can communicate directly with Ms. Reham by attending Reham Diva club sessions, where Ms. Reham receives your questions about Reham Diva programs.

items.question: Are there discussion groups or a community for subscribers?
items.answer: Yes. We want to help you join a positive, aware and enlightened community interested in femininity and self-love. We are working on announcing the opening of the Reham Diva community soon.

items.question: Does Ms. Reham offer individual coaching sessions?
items.answer: Yes. You can contact customer service for more details.

items.question: Does Ms. Reham offer awareness trips on femininity and self-love?
items.answer: Yes. For more information please contact customer service.

sections.body: Reham Diva ("we," "our," or "us") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website and use our services.

list: Personal Data: Name, email address, phone number, and other contact information
Payment Information: Credit card details, billing address, and transaction history
Usage Data: Information about how you access and use our website and services
Device Information: IP address, browser type, operating system, and device identifiers

sections.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
sections.body: We use the information we collect to:
list: Provide, maintain, and improve our services
Process your transactions and send you related information
Send you technical notices, updates, and support messages
Respond to your comments, questions, and requests

sections.title: 4. Information Sharing and Disclosure
sections.body: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share your information only in the following circumstances:

When required by law or to respond to legal process
To protect our rights, privacy, safety, or property

However, no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is 100% secure. While we strive to use commercially acceptable means to protect your information, we cannot guarantee absolute security.

The right to rectify inaccurate or incomplete data
The right to request deletion of your personal data
The right to object to processing of your personal data

sections.title: 8. Children's Privacy
sections.body: Our services are not intended for individuals under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child has provided us with personal information, please contact us immediately.

sections.title: 9. Changes to This Privacy Policy
